targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    labelsmap['cluster'] AS cluster,
    labelsmap['namespace'] AS namespace,
    labelsmap['container'] AS container,
    count() AS alert_count
FROM alerts.alerts
WHERE 
    datetime >= $__fromTime
    AND datetime <= $__toTime
    AND labels.severity != 'info'
    AND labels.alertname LIKE '%Restart%'
    AND labelsmap['namespace'] LIKE '%$namespace%'
GROUP BY cluster, namespace, container
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;
